title: Academic Artificial Intelligence Course Prerequisites
content:
Artificial Intelligence Degree Course Prerequisites
Morgan State University Department of Computer Science

This document focuses on AI-degree course facts that were missing or newly verified for CS Navigator. Use it with the main course prerequisite document and the student's DegreeWorks record.

Sources:
- Morgan news release: https://www.morgan.edu/news/morgan-launches-artificial-intelligence-degree
- Department page: https://www.morgan.edu/computer-science/degrees-and-programs/bs_artificial-intelligence
- Catalog program page: https://catalog.morgan.edu/preview_program.php?catoid=28&poid=6725&returnto=2057
- Catalog course details supplied from Morgan catalog screenshots and the AI program PDF reviewed locally.

---

MATH AND SUPPORTING COURSES

MATH 113 - Introduction to Mathematical Analysis I
Credits: 4 | Prerequisite: None listed in the catalog snippet reviewed | Offered: Fall/Spring

MATH 114 - Introduction to Mathematical Analysis II
Credits: 4 | Prerequisite: MATH 113 (C or higher) | Offered: Fall/Spring

MGBU 200 - Introduction to Business for Non-Business Majors
Credits: 3 | Prerequisite: ENGL 101 and ENGL 102 (C or higher) and sophomore standing | Offered: Fall/Spring

---

CLCO COURSES USED BY THE AI DEGREE

CLCO 261 - Introduction to Cloud Computing
Credits: 3 | Prerequisite: COSC 112 (C or higher) | Offered: Fall/Spring

CLCO 312 - Data Science for Social Good
Credits: 3 | Prerequisite: COSC 251 (C or higher) | Offered: As needed

CLCO 341 - Machine Learning in the Cloud
Credits: 3 | Prerequisite: COSC 251 (C or higher) | Offered: As needed

CLCO 401 - Cloud Applications / Cloud and AI Applications
Credits: 3 | Prerequisite: CLCO 261 (C or higher) | Offered: Verify in Banner/catalog for the target term

CLCO 471 - Data Analytics in Cloud
Credits: 3 | Prerequisite: CLCO 261 (C or higher) | Offered: As offered

CLCO 490 - Senior Project in Cloud Computing
Credits: 3 | Prerequisite: Department Chair permission and senior standing | Offered: As needed
Note: Catalog screenshot says this course cross-lists with COSC 490.

---

ANSWERING RULES FOR CHAT

If a student asks about prerequisites for an AI-degree course, answer from the course's own prerequisite row first. If the course is offered as needed or says to verify, tell the student to check Banner for the target term and confirm with an advisor before making a registration decision.

If a student asks whether AI replaced Cloud Computing, say Morgan's official news release describes the AI B.S. as a reimagining of the former Cloud Computing B.S. Do not tell a legacy Cloud Computing student that their curriculum automatically changed; their DegreeWorks catalog year controls their requirements.
